Reproduced ImportCandidateConcurrencyTest flake on clean main HEAD (22/35 runs failed, always concurrentCompleteAndCreatePreserveBatchInvariant). Confirmed real production bug (not test isolation) via raw two-session psql repro independent of Hibernate: ImportBatch.complete() conditional UPDATE (NOT EXISTS subquery on import_candidates) blocks on the same row-lock held by ImportCandidateService.create() (findByIdForUpdate/PESSIMISTIC_WRITE), but after the lock holder commits, the blocked UPDATE re-evaluates only the locked row itself (EvalPlanQual) -- the NOT EXISTS subquery on a different table still uses the original pre-block snapshot (documented Postgres READ COMMITTED caveat), so complete() can spuriously succeed even though a PENDING candidate was just committed. Designed minimal fix: make complete() reuse the same findByIdForUpdate() lock already used by create(), then check existsByImportBatchIdAndStatus() as a separate fresh SELECT after acquiring the lock (fresh READ COMMITTED snapshot correctly sees concurrent commits). Applied this fix locally and verified: ImportCandidateConcurrencyTest 0/25 failures (vs 22/35 baseline), full suite 185/185, no DB leaks -- then reverted before handing to Codex per AGENTS.md (Codex implements application code). Wrote ADR-0025 correcting ADR-0022 decision 4. User explicitly approved a minimal production code change despite FIX-002 prompt listing "production locking strategy change" as forbidden, since the fix reuses an already-approved PESSIMISTIC_WRITE primitive rather than introducing a new one.
